builds.desc: It's a triple ploy build that will ploy pretty much the entire arena. Not a lot to say.

builds.name: Power Prodigy
builds.desc: A very strong Player Phase build focusing on Lute's naturally high attack and good speed with a combination of ploy skills to ensure getting a cooldown boost from Heavy Blade. I recommend Lancebreaker or Desperation to cover some of the more bulky high atk lance users or Desperation for general purpose. Consider having Eirika or another red support unit with Drive Atk 2 to further increase your chances to proc Heavy Blade.
